_doc: The manifest Hardtech-CAD reads (libs:cad-core ModelManifest). One entry per model: id, name, library (boats | architecture), format (lower-case extension family), path (repo-relative, LFS), source, licence, size (bytes), sha256 (of the file at path). `view` is an optional derived, triangulated GLB of the same model for phones (path, size, sha256, tool); the original stays the source of truth. `conversion` says why a closed format has no view yet.

models.name: One Lilo, 36 m sailing yacht
models.source: Owner's own file (Google Drive, archive 36-meter-sailing-yacht-1.snapshot.9.zip, member OneLilo.igs)

view.tool: tools/brep2glb.mjs with occt-import-js 0.0.23 (LGPL-2.1), linear deflection 0.004 of the bounding box, merged by colour
